Hi Clare,

Here is the workflow I was hoping for:
* 3 annotators each label
* Create consensus label with rectification
   * pixel receives label “lumen” if >=50% of labelers assign pixel “lumen”
   * if pixel would receive both “lumen” and “adventitia” labels only
“lumen” is applied
* Reviewer reviews consensus label

Best,

Jocelyn
